# MASSOLIT

> > MASSOLIT delivers short video lectures from world-class academics across 18+ subjects, specializing in GCSE, A-Level, and IB exam preparation.

MASSOLIT is a comprehensive online learning platform offering 1,400+ video lectures taught by top university professors and subject experts. The platform covers core academic subjects aligned with major exam specifications including AQA, OCR, and Edexcel, serving students preparing for GCSE, A-Level, and International Baccalaureate qualifications.

## Key Topics

- GCSE
- A-Level
- International Baccalaureate (IB)
- Video Lectures
- Exam Preparation
- Online Learning
- AQA
- OCR
- Edexcel
- Cambridge IGCSE
- School Subscriptions
- Academic Content
- Subject Courses
- Exam Specifications
- Educational Platform

- [MASSOLIT – Philosophy & Religious Studies](https://massolit.io/subjects/philosophy/landing): 115 Philosophy & Religious Studies courses for GCSE and A-Level
- [MASSOLIT – Government & Politics](https://massolit.io/subjects/government-politics/landing): 95 Government & Politics courses covering theory, IB, and A-Level curricula
- [MASSOLIT – English Language](https://massolit.io/subjects/english-language/landing): 70 English Language courses for GCSE and A-Level exams

- [MASSOLIT – Law](https://massolit.io/subjects/law/landing): 33 Law courses including criminal, tort, human rights, and contract law
